Class MenuBlock<C extends BlockMenu>

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour
net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block
org.moddingx.libx.base.BlockBase
org.moddingx.libx.base.MenuBlock<C>
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement, net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike, net.neoforged.neoforge.common.extensions.IBlockExtension, CreativeTabItemProvider, Registerable
public class MenuBlock<C extends BlockMenu> extends BlockBase
This class registers a menu with the Block. This also makes the Screen appear on right-click.

Note: You need to register the Screen by yourself using the MenuScreens register function.
